metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the bow, Egeon at two, the parlour, the glass, the purse, the one sentence, and a shut gate on the Strand.

yesterday: The king was whole. The parliament was in it. The public roll at the Theatre is still the cut one.
Five pounds, and twelve and six the share. The four-shilling glass stayed outside the five. Nobody asked what the king had meant.
His sentence was that it was very well penned, and that he had not thought to be made to pity him, and that he would remember that it can be done.
There was no boat home. Heminges took the boys and the baskets in the cart. You walked.
